name: openvan-travel-data
title: OpenVan.camp travel data — daily snapshots
description: Daily snapshots of the OpenVan.camp public API: retail fuel prices in 170+ countries, EUR exchange rates, food cost index, vanlife weather scores, plus reference data on toll roads, power plugs, holidays, customs, license plates and passport ranking.

resources.name: fuel-prices
resources.description: Current retail fuel price per country and grade, in local currency and local unit (liter, US gallon or imperial gallon).

fields.name: grade
fields.description: gasoline, gasoline_premium, diesel, diesel_premium, lpg, cng, e85, …

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency of this grade (can differ from the country currency)

resources.name: fuel-prices-history
resources.description: Daily rows of fuel-prices, one file per year (history/fuel-prices-YYYY.csv), with a leading date column.

resources.name: currency-rates
resources.description: Units of each currency per 1 EUR.

resources.name: vanbasket
resources.description: Food cost index by country, world average = 100 (World Bank ICP 2021 baseline).

resources.name: vansky-weather
resources.description: Vanlife weather suitability by country: van_score 0–100 and sleep / drive / solar / sea sub-scores.
